scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix server" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
